entry.title: CVE-2026-65982 HIGH
entry.summary: nginx-http-flv-module is a media streaming server based on nginx-rtmp-module. Prior to version 1.2.14, if a server received an HTTP/1.0 request without a header Host, which was permitted by HTTP core of Nginx, then r->headers_in.host was NULL, nginx-http-flv-module used r->headers_in.host->value to make a pseudo tcUrl, so NULL-pointer dereference happened. This issue has been patched in version 1…

entry.title: CVE-2026-123866 HIGH
entry.summary: A use-after-free in Node.js HTTP/2 stream teardown can leak response memory, including the contents of other connections' response buffers, to a peer. entry.title: CVE-2026-123874 HIGH

entry.title: CVE-2026-106023 UNSCORED
entry.summary:
NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server's mod_md during HTTP request processing.
This issue affects Apache HTTP Server: from 2.4.30 through 2.4.69.

entry.title: CVE-2026-109163 UNSCORED
entry.summary:
Stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server's mod_vhost_alias (after CVE-2026-63292)
This issue affects Apache HTTP Server: 2.4.69.
